title: Cross-commit dynamic-experiment content-object handle
description: Imports one immutable object from an earlier verified content-graph commit without copying or trusting its historical object path. source_commit_reference identifies the exact portable graph commit and graph artifact, while object_ref identifies the exact bytes and canonical meaning to reopen there. Runtime validation must verify the source commit and complete graph first, resolve object_ref as a locally owned member of that graph, and reject absent, ambiguous, changed, or transitively re-exported objects.
